metadata.archetype_justification: Database connections via <cfquery> datasource and document CRUD operations (search, download) detected. The application owns persistent state (SQL Server database and local file storage) and exposes read/write operations on document entities.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 1.18 yields Not Ready band but 11 High findings yield Remediation Required tier via '2-11 High' rule. The score-based band is authoritative — nearly every question scores 1, indicating the system is genuinely Not Ready. The count-based rule has a high threshold (≥12) for Not Ready which this repo narrowly misses at 11 High. Score-based band governs.

findings.title: Managed Compute — all workloads on raw EC2
findings.description: All compute runs on a single raw EC2 Windows Server 2008 instance with IIS 7 and Adobe ColdFusion 8. No managed container orchestration or serverless.
findings.gap: No managed compute services in use. Entire application on manually-provisioned, unsupported Windows EC2 instance.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed compute. Lambda behind API Gateway for cost-effectiveness, or ECS on Fargate for traditional web server pattern.

findings.title: Managed Databases — self-managed SQL Server 2005
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 is self-managed on the EC2 instance. No RDS, no Aurora, no managed database services.
findings.gap: Database entirely self-managed with no automated failover, no managed backups, no patching. Engine 10+ years past EOL.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS for SQL Server (minimal change) or Aurora PostgreSQL (recommended for cost and open-source benefits).

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — no orchestration capability
findings.description: No workflow orchestration service detected. Application performs simple document search and file download with no multi-step business operations.
findings.gap: No orchestration infrastructure for future workflow needs.
findings.recommendation: When rebuilding, adopt Step Functions for any multi-step workflows (document approval, processing pipelines).

findings.title: Async Messaging — no messaging infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. All operations are synchronous HTTP request-response. For a stateful-crud service, state changes should use managed messaging.
findings.gap: No async messaging capability. No event-driven state propagation.
findings.recommendation: When rebuilding, adopt EventBridge or SNS/SQS for document lifecycle events.

findings.title: Network Security — no VPC/security group configuration
findings.description: No VPC configuration, security groups, or network segmentation defined. Application runs HTTP only on internal network with no HTTPS.
findings.gap: No network security configuration visible. Service runs without encryption in transit and without proper network segmentation.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in VPC with private subnets. Use security groups with least-privilege rules. Enforce HTTPS via ALB or API Gateway.

findings.title: API Entry Point — direct service exposure
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, CloudFront, or managed entry point. ColdFusion application accessed directly on IIS with no throttling or request validation.
findings.gap: Direct service exposure with no managed entry point.
findings.recommendation: Place an ALB or API Gateway in front of the application for throttling, auth, and request validation.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — single instance, no scaling
findings.description: No auto-scaling configured. Application runs on a single EC2 instance with static capacity.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned. Cannot respond to traffic spikes.
findings.recommendation: After migrating to managed compute, configure auto-scaling with target tracking on CPU/request count.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no backups configured
findings.description: No backup configuration found. README states 'no backups offsite.' Documents on local disk with no replication. Database has no backup retention.
findings.gap: No automated backups. Disk loss = data loss. No PITR, no restore procedures.
findings.recommendation: Migrate files to S3 with versioning. Use RDS automated backups with PITR. Implement AWS Backup plans.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code — 0% coverage
findings.description: No IaC exists. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or any IaC files. All infrastructure is manually created.
findings.gap: No infrastructure as code. Cannot reproduce environment, no audit trail, no disaster recovery automation.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in CDK or Terraform. Start with new architecture rather than codifying legacy state.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no pipeline exists
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Deployment is manual file copy over network share. No GitHub Actions, no CodePipeline, no build/test/deploy stages.
findings.gap: No CI/CD automation. All deployments manual. No quality gates.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with CodePipeline + CodeBuild. Include lint, test, security scan, build, and deploy stages.

findings.title: Programming Languages — ColdFusion 8 (unsupported, no cloud tooling)
findings.description: Application written in CFML on Adobe ColdFusion 8 (2007, unsupported). Limited/no AWS SDK support, no cloud-native tooling.
findings.gap: Language with limited or no AWS SDK and no cloud-native tooling. Requires migration to a modern language.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite in Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or Java — all have first-class AWS SDK support and mature cloud-native ecosystems.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices — tightly-coupled monolith
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries. 2 ColdFusion files with inline SQL, HTML, and business logic co-located. No separation of concerns.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with pervasive shared state. No module boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Given trivial complexity (~80 LOC), rewrite as properly structured application with API/business/data layers. See Decomposition Strategy.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication — all synchronous
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. No async patterns. For stateful-crud, state changes that should propagate asynchronously are handled synchronously.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns. No event-driven state propagation.
findings.recommendation: When rebuilding, implement async patterns for document lifecycle events using SNS/SQS or EventBridge.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — all synchronous
findings.description: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No async job processing infrastructure exists for potential long-running operations.
findings.gap: No async job processing. No mechanism for operations exceeding 30 seconds.
findings.recommendation: When rebuilding, implement async patterns for long operations. Use Step Functions or SQS workers with status polling.

findings.title: API Versioning — no versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning. URLs are unversioned (index.cfm, download.cfm). No version headers, no versioned paths.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly.
findings.recommendation: When rebuilding, implement URL-based versioning (e.g., /v1/documents).

findings.title: Service Discovery — all endpoints hard-coded
findings.description: All service endpoints hard-coded. Database datasource configured in CF Administrator GUI. File paths hardcoded (D:\docroot\files\).
findings.gap: All endpoints hard-coded with no dynamic discovery or environment-based configuration.
findings.recommendation: Use environment variables or SSM Parameter Store for service configuration. For multi-service architectures, adopt Cloud Map.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage — local disk, no S3
findings.description: Documents stored on local disk at D:\docroot\files. No S3, no managed object storage, no parsing pipeline.
findings.gap: Data on local filesystem. Single disk failure = total data loss. No object storage, no backups, no parsing.
findings.recommendation: Migrate documents to S3. Use presigned URLs for download. Add Textract for parsing. Enable versioning and lifecycle policies.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer — inline SQL scattered in templates
findings.description: Database queries are inline SQL in ColdFusion templates. No repository pattern, no DAO, no ORM. SQL mixed with presentation logic.
findings.gap: Queries scattered across files with no data access pattern.
findings.recommendation: Implement a proper data access layer (repository pattern) with parameterized queries.

findings.title: Database Engine Version — SQL Server 2005 EOL
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 — reached EOL April 2016. Over 10 years past EOL. No security patches, no vendor support.
findings.gap: Engine at EOL. No version pinning. No update procedure. Critical compliance and security risk.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to supported engine: RDS SQL Server 2019/2022 or Aurora PostgreSQL.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — no encryption configured
findings.description: No encryption at rest for any data store. Documents unencrypted on local disk. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for database or file storage. Data stored in plaintext.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to S3 with SSE-KMS. Use RDS/Aurora with encryption enabled (customer-managed KMS key).

findings.title: API Authentication — session-based, no OAuth2/JWT
findings.description: Application uses ColdFusion session-based authentication. No OAuth2/JWT, no token rotation, session fixation vulnerability.
findings.gap: Session-based auth without token-based auth. Session fixation vulnerability. No modern auth standards.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Cognito with OAuth2/OIDC. Implement JWT validation on all endpoints.

findings.title: Centralized Identity — no IdP integration
findings.description: Application manages its own authentication entirely. No integration with centralized IdP. No SSO, no SAML, no OIDC.
findings.gap: Application manages own auth with no external IdP. No SSO capability.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Cognito for SAML/OIDC federation to corporate directory. Enable SSO.

findings.title: Secrets Management — plaintext credentials in repository
findings.description: Plaintext credentials documented in README.md (password 'cfadmin'). Database credentials in CF Administrator GUI with no secrets management.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in repository. No secrets management, no rotation, no encryption.
findings.recommendation: Remove credentials from repository. Migrate all secrets to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: Compute Hardening — no patching, EOL OS/runtime
findings.description: No patching strategy or vulnerability scanning. Windows Server 2008 and ColdFusion 8 both past EOL with known critical CVEs.
findings.gap: No patching, no vulnerability scanning, no hardening. OS and runtime past EOL.
findings.recommendation: Migration to supported infrastructure is the only remediation. Use managed compute (Fargate/Lambda) or Bottlerocket with SSM Patch Manager.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — no security scanning
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline exists. No SAST, no dependency scanning, no container scanning.
findings.gap: No security scanning. No pipeline for security validation.
findings.recommendation: Include SAST (Semgrep), dependency scanning (Dependabot/Snyk), and container scanning in CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — no tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no trace ID propagation.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing. Cannot trace requests or diagnose latency issues.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry. Propagate trace IDs through all service calls.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — no SLOs defined
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No CloudWatch alarms. No formal service level definitions.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for document search latency and download availability. Implement CloudWatch alarms with error budgets.

findings.title: Business Metrics — no custom metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. No business metrics tracking.
findings.gap: No custom metrics. No visibility into business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for documents_searched, documents_downloaded, active_users.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection — no alerting configured
findings.description: No alerting configured. No anomaly detection, no alarms. Failures discovered by users.
findings.gap: No alerting. No visibility into system health.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency. Enable anomaly detection. Integrate with incident management.

findings.title: Integration Testing — no automated tests
findings.description: No integration tests. No unit tests. No automated tests of any kind. Zero test coverage.
findings.gap: No integration tests. Any change risks undetected regression.
findings.recommendation: Establish integration tests for critical workflows. Use appropriate testing framework (pytest, Jest, JUnit). Run in CI.

findings.title: Incident Response — no runbooks
findings.description: No runbooks, no incident response automation. Incident response is entirely ad hoc.
findings.gap: No runbooks. Incident response is ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common incidents. Implement as SSM Automation documents.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — no ownership defined
findings.description: No observability ownership. No dashboards, no alarms with owners, no team attribution.
findings.gap: No observability ownership. Monitoring reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Define per-service dashboards with named owners. Use CODEOWNERS for observability configs.

findings.title: Resource Tagging — no tags
findings.description: No resource tags found. No IaC exists to define tags. No tagging standard.
findings.gap: No tags. Cannot track costs, identify ownership, or enforce budget controls.
findings.recommendation: Implement tagging standard in IaC with mandatory tags (Environment, Service, Owner, CostCenter).
